targets.mini-stay-db: mini-stay SQLite, written by the service (be/db, both stacks open the same file)
targets.mini-stay-pricing: mini-stay pricing -- nights x nightly rate plus integer-bps tax, and cancellation refund tiers (be/api)
targets.mini-stay-booking: mini-stay booking lifecycle -- hold, confirm, check-in, check-out, cancel, hold expiry, no-show (be/api)
targets.mini-stay-availability: mini-stay inventory -- no overbooking a room for any night, including under concurrent requests (be/api)
targets.mini-stay-security: mini-stay authorization boundaries -- no/wrong/forged token, role confusion, cross-guest access (be/api)
targets.mini-stay-fe: mini-stay HTML pages -- hotels, rooms, a booking, a guest's bookings and admin overview (Playwright)
targets.frankfurter-api: frankfurter.dev public FX API (no key) -- historical-rate equality and latest shape, used to convert a stay price
